observedLiveBoundary: Secure admin middleware validates session/account/version/profile/password-change restrictions and supplies server AuthContext; the internal enrollment primitive takes review data and delegates history/freshness/locking to proposal SQL. No real reviewer issuer, original-evidence reader or enrollment route/pool is implemented.

authorizationBinding: same subject/session and all four selection fields
candidateContract.originalFormat: Candidate-only compact JSON UTF-8 round-trip representation; no whitespace, duplicate keys, alternate escapes, BOM or unknown fields. Maximum16384 bytes. This format/limit is proposed, not an approved evidence ingestion policy.
candidateContract.freshness: Existing proposal SQL outer bounds:15 minutes past/1 minute future; checked again after final authorization; SQL may reject later.
candidateContract.evidenceDigest: SHA256 of copied original bytes, not a client digest
candidateContract.reviewerReference: reviewer_subject_v1_ + SHA256(cashier-reviewer-subject-v1\0 + authenticated subjectId); maps server identity, not a browser string. Candidate convention only; pseudonymous, not anonymous.
candidateContract.output: Frozen IndependentlyReviewedEmptyDevice-shaped data only, without raw evidence, server session or evidence custody reference. Does not invoke the enrollment primitive or authorize SQL.

trustAssumptionsAndLimits: Trusted adapters are server composition dependencies, never request JSON. Tests inject synthetic adapters only.
APPROVED and custodyVerified booleans do not authenticate anything independently. Real session/policy/assignment/revocation and original authenticity/custody/observation readers remain unimplemented.

Both recognized policy models require an explicit server approval. Candidate does not grant owner_admin or appointed reviewers any live authority, select a model, implement assignments or infer approval from continuation.
Canonical JSON/hash binds bytes to interpretation; it is not a signature, source authenticity proof or independent queue observation.

Final authorization recheck does not make preparation and later database enrollment atomic. A source implementation must define session/policy revocation at the transaction boundary and binding of one-time evidence/review reuse; no route may wire this candidate before those decisions and tests.
Original-evidence reader access, custody, retention, signing, namespace uniqueness and review reference issuance remain explicit design dependencies.
No all-operation recovery, client activation, physical device acceptance, operational provisioning, retention approval or hosted proof.
Application/canonical/source acceptance remains699; these69 tests are separate from prior826/92/9 denominators.
